SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Honestly, I wanna give you a big hug right now—

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau boleh, Kakak pengin peluk erat kamu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se pudesse, eu te daria um abraço bem forte agora,

SCRIPT.PERSIAN: دلم می‌خواست سفت بغلت کنم و بچلونمت،

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But look at the state I’m in.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 但我现在这副样子就算了吧

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi lihat kondisi Kakak sekarang, jadi nggak bisa.

SCRIPT.SPANISH: mira el estado en el que estoy.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ولی این ریخت و قیافه‌مو که می‌بینی...

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kakak kenapa? Apa ada yang terjadi?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن ببینم... تو خودت چت شده چرا این شکلی شدی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Once I’m better, let’s go grab a drink.

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau nanti udah sembuh semua, kita minum bareng ya.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Aren’t you uncomfortable sitting like that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过你这样一直躺着不难受吗？

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi posisi kayak gitu terus nggak capek?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Okay... let’s hang out later then. Get some rest.
